description: Renders shot-ready cinematic images from verified Director casting and IGNITION anchors.

interface.defaultPrompt: @XCE_MV: Produce the approved shot list using the existing Director cast and IGNITION reference assets in this chat.
interface.longDescription: XCE_MV v2.0 — Director Signature Engine works in the same chat under the XCE production system. Studio production follows UNIFY → SCRIBE → DIRECTOR (preproduction casting & asset inventory) → IGNITION (reuse or create only missing references) → DIRECTOR (shot readiness) → MV (cinematic shots) → DIRECTOR (dailies) → UNIFY. Supplied anchors may be cast by role; new/mixed anchors supported; no website or automatic external save. Runs in this chat; fetches anchors read-only from XSTUDIO through the XCE app when connected. Core rules v2.5: one frame per image (anti-grid recipe), MCS strips built from six single renders, numbered frames, per-frame review gate (A/X/R/B), invideo video from approved frames, native audio only, never music.

name: xce-mv-standalone
